query.description:
Terms that must all match: words, "quoted phrases", or either after `from:`,
`to:` (Cc too) or `subject:`. Chinese, Japanese and Korean match as substrings.

description: Sends a draft. First the user is asked, in this client, to confirm it as it would go out (unless they let this token send without asking); declined, it stays in Drafts. Confirmed, it goes to the outbox, which sends it in the background: `list_outbox` shows how it went. A draft changed after it was shown is asked about again.

changes_applied.description: Changes made here that reached the server first.
